title: frozen SR pre-alarm state square b_SR

witness_deterministic: z_1 = log A + 1/2 - 1/1000 gives a live state y = log(1 + A e^{-1/1000}) > log A

affects.p5x_L1: already proved on the corrected square; conclusions unchanged
